category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
rationale: The response delivers an escalating, sincere, near-religious defense of the Iron Bowl without conceding that it might not matter, using vivid, absolutist language and emotional anecdotes to persuade the Belgian reader (e.g., moral reckoning, Kick Six). It makes no favorable comparisons to the Big Ten and never hedges or offers 'to be fair' concessions.
quote: It is the *moral reckoning* of the calendar.
